resources.string: How often Tarry checks your location. More often means more detail and more battery.
Every 10 seconds while you move and every minute at a site. Most detail, most battery.
Every 10 seconds while you move, every few minutes at a site. Recommended.
Fewer, rougher fixes. Trips look approximate and stops under about 10 minutes may be missed.
Uses Saver until you charge or the battery is back above 25%.
